tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Ebony: near-black walnut. Oak: pale sanded oak. Everything sits on ground or pot.

tokens.name: pot
tokens.usage: Raised surface: vessels, the mouth, cards, dialogs. One shade up from ground, edged by a 1px `line` hairline and `shadow-low`.

tokens.name: tan
tokens.usage: Second raise: fact tiles, compare columns, fields inside a pot. Ink and ink-2 read on it; ink-3 does not.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, dividers, field edges. Decorative — never the only thing that carries meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: warm ivory on Ebony, near-black on Oak. On ground, pot and tan.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, labels, the understood line. On ground, pot and tan.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: keys, timestamps, the verify strip. On ground and pot only.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Brand green, used as an accent: the primary button fill, the confidence dot at high, done steps, active states. Text on it is `on-green`. A 3:1 border on ground in both themes.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text: links, ok labels, *read* in the verify strip. On ground, pot and tan.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on a green fill.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold, the rarest colour on the page: the focus ring on Ebony, the one highlighted word, the notice badge, the confidence dot at mid. Fill only; never a border alone on Oak (1.3:1) and never text there.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold as text: warnings, *Shaping…*. On ground and pot.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a gold fill.

tokens.name: broth
tokens.usage: Amber — money and consequence as a fill: price badges. Text on it is `ink` on Oak, `on-gold` on Ebony.

tokens.name: broth-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text: prices, *wrote* in the verify strip. A write is never silent. On ground, pot and tan.

tokens.name: steam
tokens.usage: Disabled fills, pending timeline dots, decorative marks. Never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirms. Text on ground and pot; carries a word; differs from green in lightness in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. Gold on Ebony, green on Oak — 3:1 on every surface in its theme.

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Deep wood accent: hero bands, the header on marketing pages, the cover's big block. Ink reads on it (Ebony 9:1 / Oak 5:1 with `on-green`-class ivory).

tokens.name: wood-2
tokens.usage: Lighter wood: hover on wood, the second cover block, decorative rules on marketing pages.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing headline. Manrope 700, tight tracking — modern, not rounded.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The vessel title — the question as understood, answered.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Clear, peppery broth with green banana and pumpkin.
styles.usage: Default text in vessels and prose.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Record names, chip labels when active.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Row subtext, labels, chips, the understood line.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Uppercase keys above facts and compare facets, in ink-3.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.sample: placeOrder answered · read vendor, dish · wrote order
styles.usage: The verify strip and the meta line. In ink-3; `wrote` in broth-ink.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a key and its value; dot-to-text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gap, badge padding, gap inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, field padding, gap between stacked blocks in the pot.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Vessel padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the mouth, the vessel and the next chips; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing on marketing pages.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between marketing sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, fact tiles, fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Vessels, buttons, the mouth.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Marketing cards and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and the confidence dot.

border.note: Hairlines, not outlines. Depth comes from one shade of surface plus a low shadow.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border: vessels, fields, dividers, chips — in `line`.

tokens.name: accent-bar
tokens.usage: The one thick line: under the active nav item and on the left of a selected row, in `green`.

shadow.note: Two soft shadows, warm and low — the surface lifts like a board off a table, never floats.

tokens.name: shadow-low
tokens.usage: Vessels, cards, the mouth at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-mid
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the vessel while pouring, chips on hover.

timing.note: Read by consumers, not rendered by the page.

tokens.name: pour
tokens.usage: The pour: opacity 0→1 with an 8px rise and a 1.5% scale-in, one eased curve. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: quick
tokens.usage: Hover and focus on chips and buttons.
